desc: Absolute white. Base background for Boozt, foreground text for ON. Used as the root light-surface primitive.
Near-black (not pure #000000). Base background for ON, foreground text for Boozt. The slight warmth avoids harsh contrast on screens.
Lightest neutral. Elevated surface backgrounds — cards on white, input field fills, table row alternation.
Muted surface. Disabled input backgrounds, skeleton loading fills, subtle divider backgrounds.
Default borders. Card outlines, input field strokes, table cell dividers, separator lines.
Placeholder text. Input hints, disabled button text, secondary icons in inactive states.
Outline / mid-gray. Active borders, focus ring fallback, subtle icon fills, form field outlines.
Secondary text on light backgrounds. Helper text, captions, metadata, timestamps.
Muted foreground. Paragraph body text on light backgrounds, secondary labels, subtitle text.
Reserved for dark-mode surface variants, hover states on dark backgrounds.
Primary text on light backgrounds. Headings, body text, high-emphasis labels. ON surface fill.
Reserved for deepest dark surface, or highest-contrast text where 800 isn't enough.
Container background. Toast/banner backgrounds, notification panels, inline alert fills. Lightest tint.
Default state. The primary utility color — icon fills, badge backgrounds, status indicator dots, button fills.
Placeholder. Reserved for subtle borders on utility containers, or light hover tints.
Hover state. Interactive element hover — buttons, links, icon hover. One step darker than default.
Placeholder. Reserved for active/focus ring tints or mid-weight status borders.
Pressed state. Button press, active toggle, selected tab indicator. Deepest interactive state.
Placeholders. Reserved for text-on-container (600–700), high-contrast utility text (800), darkest anchor (900).
